fusions.name: Catchbriar Line
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile line of hooked briars ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeling Thorn
fusions.desc: Hooks a thorn into one enemy up to 6 tiles away and deals 16 damage, using up every affliction you have on it; each one used up adds 60% more damage.

fusions.name: Burdock Snag
fusions.desc: Scatters clinging burs that pull up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Tithe
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
